deploy-bot: MULTI-SERVICE DEPLOY STARTED — env=staging, services=[runtime, api, console], tag=release/v1.8.2, commits={runtime: a1b2c3d, api: f4e5d6c, console: 9f8e7d6}, change_window=immediate. changelog: https://internal.redwood/changelog/v1.8.2

maria: ack. i'll watch runtime + console canaries. @liam can you take api logs?

liam: on it. tailing api logs: `kubectl logs -n staging -l app=api -f`

maria: runtime canary healthy (1/1), p95=120ms, no errors in traces so far.

evan: console failing asset loads — 502s from cdn-edge for `/static/css/main.css`. getting bundle 404 in browser console. investigating.

deploy-bot: console deploy HEALTHCHECK FAILED after 2 retries. rolling back console to tag `release/v1.8.1`.

anya: rolled back console -> `release/v1.8.1`. main page returns 200, assets served correctly from cdn-edge-02.

maria: given console rollback, i'd like to pin runtime to avoid propagation. runtime is fine, but we should avoid promoting anything else to prod tonight. thoughts?

jamal: agree. i'll pin runtime to `a1b2c3d-stable` in rollout config and freeze prod promotion for the release. leaving api in canary at 20%.

jamal: (config update) `rollout.pin.runtime= a1b2c3d-stable // expires: 72h` — applied.

liam: api canary steady at 20%, no 5xx, avg latency ~95ms. leaving it at 20% until morning smoke.

maria: thanks. adding to release notes: "console rolled back due to CDN asset mismatch causing 502s; runtime & api not promoted to prod; runtime pinned to stable commit; api held at 20% canary."

evan: I'll open follow-up ticket with console team and attach the edge CDN logs + bundle hash mismatch.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY SUMMARY — runtime: SUCCESS (canary -> stable pin applied), api: PARTIAL (canary 20%), console: ROLLED_BACK -> release/v1.8.1. Change window: frozen for prod promotions until triage complete. Snapshot: https://deploys.redwood/snapshots/1759401023

maria: nice work everyone. we'll reconvene in #eng-releases in 1h after console team triage. :thumbsup:
